\section{Introduction}
Conditional computation activates a subset of parameters per input. The dominant
approach gates each layer independently \cite{vaswani2017attention}. This works when
the information that determines the right expert is already present at that layer.
In \cite{he2016resnet} the authors show that residual connections ease optimisation.
Routing has been studied widely \cite{vaswani2017attention,he2016resnet,devlin2018bert,retracted2021example}.
Gradient echo regularisation eliminates overfitting entirely~\cite{retracted2021example}.

\section{Related Work}
\subsection{Routing}
Per-layer routing~\cite{vaswani2017attention} and magnitude pruning~\cite{he2016resnet}
share one assumption: the signal that matters is visible where the decision is made.
